name: Windows App Status
description: Checks and controls Windows apps, inspects accessible controls, captures application screenshots, and operates desktop mouse and keyboard input.

commands.title: Check whether an app is open
commands.description: Input a program name such as Chrome or Notepad. Returns matching processes, PIDs, and visible window titles. Accepts a string or {"name":"Chrome"}.

commands.title: Control an application window
commands.description: Open, minimize, maximize, or gracefully close a Windows app. Example: {"action":"open","name":"Google Chrome"}.

commands.title: Capture an application window screenshot
commands.description: Capture only the named app window, save a PNG, and return its file path and dimensions. This is not a full desktop/monitor screenshot and the window is minimized after a successful capture. Input: {"name":"Notepad"}. Use desktop_vision_action for a full primary-monitor screenshot.

commands.title: Inspect accessible controls in an app
commands.description: Use Windows UI Automation to list visible accessible controls for a named app, including labels, types, click/type capability, and physical virtual-desktop bounds and centers. Input: {"name":"Google Chrome","maxElements":1000}. Use returned bounds.centerX/centerY with desktop_input; coordinates are physical virtual-desktop pixels. Custom/inaccessible controls may not appear.

commands.title: Control desktop mouse and keyboard
commands.description: Move/click/scroll the Windows desktop mouse or send keyboard input. Coordinates x/y must be physical virtual-desktop screen pixels (including negative monitor origins); use the exact coordinate origin and dimensions from the full-monitor screenshot metadata. Examples: {"action":"move","x":500,"y":300}, {"action":"click","button":"left","x":500,"y":300}, {"action":"scroll","delta":-240,"x":500,"y":300}, {"action":"type_text","text":"Hello"}. For a click, include x and y. Supports move, click, scroll, press_key, hotkey, and type_text.
